[[File:Wilbur.png|thumb|250px|Wilbur]] '''Wilbur''' (Japanese: '''飛太''' ''Tobio'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP211|Fly Me to the Moon]]''. Wilbur lives on [[Pudgy Pidgey Isle]], and is the sole caretaker of all the {{p|Pidgey}} who live there. Out of all the Pidgey on the island, the one he is closest to is [[Orville]]. Unlike the other Pidgey, Orville had a desire to fly as high as he could. Wilbur promised to help Orville achieve that goal. Joined by {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and {{TRT}}, Wilbur flew in a [[Air transportation in the Pokémon world|hot air balloon]] behind Orville when he made his attempt to fly to the moon. Although Wilbur wasn't able to follow his friend all the way, he kept in contact with Orville the entire way. When Orville fell due to lack of oxygen, Wilbur and {{AP|Pikachu}} saved his life. After Orville's flight, the other Pidgey began to show signs of flying. Wilbur hoped that thanks to Orville, the other Pidgey on the island would get into shape and start flying too. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ===Cares for=== {{TrainerPoké |main=Orville |trainer=Wilbur |pkmn=Pidgey |nick=Orville |gender=male |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Orville.png |epnum=EP211 |epname=Fly Me to the Moon |vaen= |vajp= |desc='''Orville''' (Japanese: '''オルドリン''' ''Aldrin'') is Wilbur's main Pokémon who is the leader of a flock of Pidgey that he owns.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wilbur |pkmn=Pidgey (multiple) |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Wilbur Pidgey.png |cap=Wilbur's Pidgey |epnum=EP211 |epname=Fly Me to the Moon |desc=Wilbur also cares for many other {{p|Pidgey}} that live at the lodge on [[Pudgy Pidgey Isle]]. They were chubbier than normal Pidgey and over the years forgot how to fly, but Orville inspired them to fly again. None of their moves are known.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{flying color light}} |ja=伊藤健太郎 ''Kentarō Itō'' |en=[[Wayne Grayson]] |pt_br=Wendel Bezerra |es_eu=Pablo Sevilla |pl=Aleksander Gawek |nl=Pepijn Gunneweg}} ==Trivia== * In the dub, Wilbur and Orville are named after the {{wp|Wright Brothers}}. * Wilbur's Japanese contains トビ ''Tobi'', from the verb 飛ぶ ''tobu'', "to fly".
